model.name: DistributedRamanFiber
model.propagator: in-house symmetric NumPy SSFM (never PyNLO path)
model.pump_model_detail: Pump powers are state variables integrated with RK4 along z at 25 m steps. The signal is represented by its in-band total power (both polarisations) at the channel-plan centre frequency. Depleted pump profiles then drive the per-frequency Raman gain inside the SSFM. Backward pumps close the boundary value problem by fixed-point iteration.
model.signal_effects: loss + CD + Kerr retained; channel ISRS not modelled
model.ase: not included in this reference dataset (dra_ase_model='none')

nli_method: Per channel, fit one complex scalar a to NL ≈ a*LIN in the channel band, then take the band power of the residual NL-a*LIN as NLI. This removes the common phase/gain that a coherent receiver would equalize. nli_power_raw_w (no fit) is also recorded. out_linear uses the same pumps/loss/CD but n2=0.
notes: Same grid and NLI extraction as dra_reference.json; only the pump model differs.
Pumps are depleted by the signal but have no pump-pump Raman transfer.
The 1ch probe isolates SPM; the 3ch power sweep tests NLI ∝ P^3.

3ch.nli_definition: In-band additive NLI after one complex common-gain projection NL-a*LIN; 50 GHz ideal rectangular analysis band; SNR_NLI=signal/NLI; no ASE.
3ch.purpose: 3-channel depleted-pump counterpart of dra_reference; compare on_off_gain_db and snr_nli_db against the undepleted dataset.

1ch.purpose: Single-channel SPM probe: one channel, no XPM, used to separate SPM from XPM under pumping.
